answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The ember holds work receipts rather than names, so the ridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
